name: NASA C-MAPSS Turbofan Engine Degradation Simulation Dataset
description: The Commercial Modular Aero-Propulsion System Simulation (C-MAPSS) dataset is the foundational benchmark for Remaining Useful Life (RUL) estimation in predictive maintenance. Simulated run-to-failure data from a fleet of commercial turbofan engines across four sub-datasets (FD001-FD004) track 21 sensor channels under varied flight operating regimes and fault modes.
